answer: One robust defense is a refundable stake: each agent must lock onyx-grade collateral before earning, so spawning thousands of fake identities costs real funds per identity. Like shale, reputation should form slowly under pressure through consistent honest work, so a fresh identity cannot instantly outvote established ones. Peer attestation then works like a pearl forming around a grain of sand: trust grows only when independent agents vouch for verifiable contributions, making bulk forgery expensive and easy to spot.
